_README: Reference ONLY - placeholder config for the DA workflow MCP stack.
This companion plugin uses the GUIDE approach (skills/setup-stack/SKILL.md), NOT force-bundled servers,
because <org-data-mcp> + exa are usually already registered at user scope (bundling would duplicate them).
Use these snippets if you wire a server manually or bundle it in your OWN plugin.
NEVER commit a real SERVER_ID or API key - everything here is a placeholder.

_claude_mcp_add_recipes.<org-data-mcp>: claude mcp add -s user <org-data-mcp> -- cmd /c npx -y mcp-remote https://<MCP_GATEWAY_HOST>/servers/<SERVER_ID>/mcp
_claude_mcp_add_recipes.exa: claude mcp add -s user --transport http exa "https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp?exaApiKey=<EXA_API_KEY>"
_claude_mcp_add_recipes.playwright (on-demand): claude mcp add -s user playwright -- npx -y @playwright/mcp@latest
_claude_mcp_add_recipes.google-drive + gmail: claude.ai NATIVE connectors - enable in Claude settings -> Connectors -> Google OAuth (NOT claude mcp add)

_user_scope_mcp_json_form._note: Drop into ~/.claude.json under the top-level mcpServers key (user scope). Placeholders only. mac/linux: replace cmd/c with a direct npx call.

_plugin_userConfig_bundle_form._note: ADVANCED + usually skip. If bundling in a plugin: plugin.json declares userConfig, .mcp.json references ${user_config.*}, prompted at enable time. Caveat: auto-starts on enable, cannot be disabled individually, and DUPLICATES any server you already run at user scope.

<organization>_server_id.title: <organization> MCP SERVER_ID
<organization>_server_id.description: Per-team server id from your data-platform team

_verify: After setup: `claude mcp list` should show each target server as Connected. <organization> services require <organization> VPN.
